glav_novel_view.description: Held-out novel-view synthesis under global and local appearance variation (paper Table 1 protocol): each held-out capture's appearance may be fitted on its left half only; quality is measured on its right half. Scored on the 6 hidden test scenes x 6 held-out captures.

psnr.description: Mean PSNR (dB) over held-out right halves.

ssim.description: Mean SSIM (11x11 Gaussian window) over held-out right halves.

lpips.description: Mean LPIPS (v0.1, AlexNet) over held-out right halves.

glav_novel_view._scale_note: Result values are the paper's GLAV Table 1 numbers (seven real 1080p captures, 30k iterations). This gym uses procedurally generated, ray-traced 96x128 scenes with 30 training and 6 held-out captures each and 6k iterations, so absolute values are not targets; the reference run in scoring/scores_test.json is what attempts are ranked against.
glav_novel_view._comparison_note: davigs_uv_depth (3D hash features -> positional encoding of pixel coordinates and depth) and davigs_no_id (no identity regulariser) are the paper's Table 4 ablations; the paper reports them only under the colour-corrected protocol (glav_average_appearance), so no paper numbers are given here.

glav_average_appearance.description: Quality of the reconstructed scene itself, rendered without any appearance model (paper Table 4 protocol: colour correction before metrics to evaluate the average appearance). The evaluator renders each method's submitted 3D Gaussian scene with its own 3DGS rasteriser at six canonical-only cameras per scene (no capture exists at these viewpoints), colour-corrects each render (mip-NeRF 360 quadratic warp) to that camera's average appearance over the training capture conditions, and scores the full frame. It doubles as the decoupling constraint: a method more than 1 dB PSNR below the evaluator's frozen reference reconstruction (the paper's method from the reference run) fails the run.

psnr.description: Mean PSNR (dB) of colour-corrected evaluator renders of the submitted scene against the average-appearance target, over 36 canonical-camera views.

ssim.description: Mean SSIM (11x11 Gaussian window) of the colour-corrected evaluator renders.

lpips.description: Mean LPIPS (v0.1, AlexNet) of the colour-corrected evaluator renders.

glav_average_appearance._scale_note: Result values are the paper's Table 4 ablation numbers on GLAV (full model, xyz -> uv + depth, w/o L_ID). The paper colour-corrects to each observed test image; this gym colour-corrects to the average appearance over the training capture conditions at canonical-only cameras (an evaluator-owned target no submitted image can be adapted to), so absolute values differ. Vanilla 3DGS is not reported in Table 4.
